# Code Coverage Report — Online Exam Portal

**Execution date:** 2026-11-20
**Source:** JaCoCo report generated by Maven `verify` for the backend.

| Measure | Covered | Total | Coverage |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Instructions | 391 | 4,816 | 8.1% |
| Lines | 53 | 419 | 12.6% |
| Methods | 19 | 129 | 14.7% |
| Branches | 26 | 284 | 9.2% |
| Classes | 4 | 30 | 13.3% |

Coverage comes from the scoring service, exam/question validation, session token service, and bearer-token filter tests. The Test Plan's 70% line-coverage target is not met. This report records the actual result rather than treating the target as achieved.

Recreate the HTML/XML/CSV evidence by running `mvn verify` in `backend/`; JaCoCo output is written to `backend/target/site/jacoco/`.
